notes.title: Still Here, Still Creating: A Quick Catch-Up!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We know it’s been a bit quiet here, but no worries, Lost in Art: A Miniature Realm is still in active development, and we’ve been working hard behind the scenes. [/p][p][/p][p]Lately, we’ve been deep into puzzle design. Maybe a bit too deep, to be honest. But some really exciting things have come out of it, and we can’t wait for you to try them. We’re also fixing bugs, polishing existing areas, and making small improvements here and there to enhance the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Now for some good news: A brand new demo is coming this August! It will feature updated versions of familiar scenes and introduce brand new puzzles. We’ll share more details later.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now. Thanks for sticking with us and supporting this cozy little adventure. Talk to you again soon.[/p]

notes.title: We’re at the Women's Day Sale Festival!
notes.notes:
Three women, one game, and a festival that gets it!

We’re at the Women's Day Sale Festival—a place that truly holds a special spot in our hearts!  We can’t wait to play incredible games from fellow creators and are beyond excited to have our game featured here, too! 

Let’s celebrate games, stories, and the amazing women bringing them to life!

notes.title: We’re Joining the Storyteller's Festival!
notes.notes:
Lost in Art: a Miniature Realm will be part of the Storyteller's Festival from February 17 to 25! 

To celebrate, we’re opening up our demo for the duration of the festival. If you haven’t had a chance to explore our world of art, mystery, and puzzles, now’s the perfect time!

Don’t forget to check out other narrative-driven gems at the festival. See you there!

notes.title: Lost in Art: A Miniature Realm is at the Myths & Legions Steam Sale!
notes.notes:
Lost in Art: A Miniature Realm is part of the Myths & Legions Steam Sale, celebrating legendary stories and heroic adventures. The event starts tonight, have fun everyone!
Don’t forget to wishlist & follow for future updates!

notes.title: Lost in Art: a Miniature Realm will be at Save & Sound!
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce that Lost in Art: a Miniature Realm will be at Save & Sound starting November 4th!

Save & Sound is an online music festival with sales and demos on Steam. Come celebrate headbanging soundtracks as well as unique implementations of music and audio in games.

We’ll be participating in the festival with a Performance Video featuring our composer, Dergah Varliel, performing music from Lost in Art. Blending traditional instruments like the santur with others, our soundtrack captures the spirit of a lost era—perfect for a journey through myths, forgotten folk tales, unique puzzles, and historical events. In Lost in Art, the music isn’t just background; it’s part of the game’s world. You can catch us on Day 2 of the festivities.

You can watch the showcase on Bedtime Digital Games’ channels: [list] 
[*] Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg]https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg[/url] 
[*] YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BedtimeDG]https://www.youtube.com/@BedtimeDG[/url]
[/list]
We’re excited to share some good music and good times with you. Check out the new trailer for Save & Sound 2024 below!

[previewyoutube=Kud112cK49c;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you enjoy the festival and see you when it goes live November 4th!

notes.title: Thanks for 1000+ Wishlists: We Need Your Thoughts!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, just wanted to say a big thank you for your interest in our game. We have been trying to reach out to you via social media and not doing well until The Wholesome Games Celebration.

We got over 1000 new wishlists in the first three days and I cannot express how excited and happy we were. It's really good to see the interest and support after months of working without knowing it. So once again, a big thank you!

We released our demo for the first time aside from offline gaming events. It's still a work in progress and we hope to be able to give you a much more polished and fun demo later on. 

Is there anyone out there who wants to share their thoughts on the demo? While the numbers make us very happy, it is always lovely to hear your thoughts.
